head: feature/task/T-054
title: F-FND-006 Event Backbone (T-006): outbox → Service Bus publish-once + dedup + in-memory fake
body:
## Summary

Closes milestone **T-006 / F-FND-006** — the event backbone: a domain event is written as an outbox row in the same transaction as business data, published once to Service Bus topic `core` with `MessageId = eventId`, and dedup'd by that identity. No Service Bus connection string → DI resolves to an in-memory fake so tests pass without a broker.

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-054-1 exact TA-5.2 envelope fields (eventId, eventType, version, occurredAtUtc, correlationId, partitionKey, payload) | T-054-06 — `EnvelopeShapeTests` asserts the serialized form per type in the closed TA-5.3 list |
| AC-054-1/2 publish exactly once, row + broker share one byte shape | T-054-03/05 — single `Serialize(envelope)` shared by outbox row and wire payload (AC-054-2); `MessageId = eventId` dedup |
| AC-054-3 replay within 15-min window skipped; idempotent-by-design after expiry | T-054-04 — `EventDeduplicator.AlreadySeen`, fake-clock younger/expired tests (T-054-06) |
| AC-054-4 round-trip without a live broker | T-054-07 — publish → store → retrieve by topic, TTL expiry via fake clock, byte-exact read-back |

EC-054-1 (publish fails after commit → row stays unpublished, PUBLISH_FAILED logged, re-publish picks it up; PK on EventId forbids a second row) covered by `OutboxRetryTests`. EC-054-2 (per-partition order via broker PartitionKey + consumers idempotent anyway). FR-054-5: same contract pointed at the SB adapter later — nothing in test code changes. TA-4.1.7 MVP simplification: at-most-once accepted for non-critical events; outbox row + alert cover the rest.

## Changes

**New code:**
- `src/wa.domain/EventEnvelope.cs` — TA-5.2 exact shape, closed TA-5.3 `EventType` list with `[JsonPropertyName]` wire names + bound `EventTypeConverter`
- `src/wa.application/Ports/Events.cs` — MediatR-free `IEventPublisher` port (TA-0.2 rule 9) + outbox row record
- `src/wa.domain/DomainEvent.cs` — EF entity (PK EventId, wire-name EventType string, NVARCHAR envelope)
- `src/wa.infrastructure/Persistence/EntityConfigurations/DomainEventsConfiguration.cs` + migration (new table = ADR row)
- `src/wa.infrastructure/Events/SbEventPublisher.cs` — SB adapter: topic `core`, MessageId=eventId, 10 s linked CTS, outbox row before publish
- `src/wa.application/Events/EventDeduplicator.cs` — consumer-side 15-min dedup by eventId (injectable clock)
- `src/wa.infrastructure/Events/InMemoryEventPublisher.cs` — test double (same contract, dedup, per-topic read-back) + DI switch on missing conn string

**New tests:** 7 xUnit total (`EnvelopeShapeTests` domain.unit, `OutboxRetryTests` api.integration, `InMemoryFakeRoundTripTests` api.integration). Testcontainers for the outbox/PK proof.

**Docs:** milestone rows 89–95 ☑, T-054-01…07 exit boxes flipped with actual counts (domain.unit 3/3, application.unit 22/22, api.integration 9/9), T-006 → done.

## Gate

Build 0 errors; domain.unit **3/3**; application.unit **22/22**; api.integration **9/9** (Docker). Web lint/test/build green.

Review: 3 parallel reviewers (domain / infra / tests) — all PASS, no majors; actionable nits/minors addressed in the follow-up commit.
